content: Rawiri tɨratu kakuniyari Kerutsareme kemɨrekwei
Merikɨtsɨ tawarita, Rawiri yukuyaxima kaniwarukuxeɨrieni 'aixɨa memɨ'anene memeuyutakwiwawe 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie kiekatari, xeitewiyari heimana tamamata miriyari mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni,

hikɨ yunaime yukuyaxima warawitɨtɨ kaneyani Wará paitɨ Kura kwieyaritsie, mana Kakaɨyari tɨratuya kakuniyari memanukwenikɨ, tɨratu kakuniyari hetsiena memehɨawe mɨkɨ kemɨtitewakɨ, Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye yuteɨtamete wahixɨata mɨti'aita.

Merikɨte Kakaɨyari kakunieya kaxeta hekwametsie mekananutiteni, hikɨ mekaneitɨni 'Awinarawi kie mekaniyekweni, mɨkɨ yemuritsie kaniukateitɨni. 'Awinarawi niwemama 'Utsa meta 'Akihu kaxeta mɨhekwa mekanehana
Kakaɨyari kakunieya matɨkɨkai. 'Akihu kakuni hɨxie 'anuyekaitɨ kaniumiekaitɨni,

meta Rawiri meyunaitɨ teɨteri 'ixaheritsixi Yawé hɨxie mekateniukaketsinakaitɨni waɨkawamekɨ meyutemamawietɨ meta me'utikwitɨ haripa 'etsimupe meta 'amupa hayuanekaku, tepu 'etsimɨyeyeu, kaitsate meta tepɨa mutitiraurɨka.
Hikɨ kepauka Nakuni tɨriku matikatse meye'axɨaka, tuurutsixi mekanetiketamɨrixɨani, hikɨ 'Utsa yumamakɨ Kakaɨyari kakunieya kaniutuika.
Hikɨ 'ayumieme, Yawé kaniuyeha'ani 'Utsa hepaɨtsita mimayɨakɨ, 'ana mana kwitɨwa katinikwinitɨani, 'Utsa 'akaniukaweni Kakaɨyari kakunieya 'aurie mɨkitɨ.
Rawiri kaniuyeha'ani Yawé 'Utsa mumiekaikɨ, 'ayumieme mana Peretsi-'Utsa
katiniuterɨwa, hikɨ 'akuxi mana mɨpaɨ katinakutewaka.
'Ana Rawiri Yawé waɨkawa 'ayemakatɨ kanayani, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «'Aixɨa pɨyɨni matsi Yawé kakunieya xɨka nekahekweni».
Mɨkayuwaɨriyakaikɨri Yawé kakunieya manukwenikɨ yukiekaritsie, katiniuta'aita pɨta 'Uweri-'Erumi kie mɨhɨiyanikɨ, Kahati kiekame hetsɨa.
Mɨpaɨ tiɨyɨku Yawé kakunieya haika metseri kaniuyurieni 'Uweri-'Erumi Kahati kiekame kie 'ukaitɨ, hikɨ Yawé 'ana mɨkɨ 'aixɨa kaniyuriekaitɨni meta yunaime tɨɨriyamama.

Kepauka ti'aitame Rawiri mɨpaɨ mɨtiuxatɨarie kename Yawé kakunieya 'Uweri-'Erumi kie mukateikɨ 'aixɨa wayuriekai tɨɨriyamama meta naime tita mɨrexeiyakai, hikɨ Rawiri kaneyani 'Uweri-'Erumi kie, Kakaɨyari kakunieya kanayekweni Rawiri kiekariena paitɨ kani'atɨani waɨkawa temawierikatsata.
Kepauka Kakaɨyari kakunieya memakwekai 'ataxewi keyari memɨye'uwekaitsie, Rawiri turu xeime kanikumemiwakaitɨni meta xeime tsikeru muwaiya, mawari memakɨnekɨ Yawé hetsiemieme.
Rawiri xeime xeikɨa 'anakatɨtɨ mawari wewiwame kamixaya 'etsimɨnena rinu 'ixurikiyarikɨ mɨwewiya, katiniutineitɨyani Yawé hɨxie waɨkawamekɨ yutemawietɨ.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenikweiximekaitɨni Yawé kakunieya yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi meta Rawiri, hiwaritsata metatsiere muxatsi wa'awate me'ɨhɨtsieximetɨ.

Hikɨ kepauka Yawé kakunieya Rawiri kiekarieyatsie meutahaximekai, Mikari Tsahuri niweya yukiitsie wapaitɨ kananiere, hikɨ kepauka Rawiri muxei 'utitsukwakame meta tineineme Yawé hɨxie, waɨkawa kanitixani'erieni.
Yawé kakunieya Rawiri 'ixuriki kiiyari kanitawewiriekaitɨni, muwa kaneitateni. Hikɨ muwata Rawiri mawari taiyariyari kaniyetuirieni meta 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyakɨ mawariyari.
'Arike mawari taiyariyari 'uwewiekari meta 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawariyari, Rawiri Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye kaniutawawirieni teɨteri yunaime 'aixɨa mɨwayurienikɨ,

meta 'ixaheritsixi yuxexuime mana memɨyuxeɨriekai memɨyumɨirekai 'ukitsi meta 'ukarawetsixi, paa kaniwarutamini, takɨ 'ikwaxiyari patsaruyari tsuirayari, meta kaxie patsaruyari papayari. 'Arike mɨpaɨ tiɨyɨku, yukie yunaitɨ mekaneutayeixɨani.

Kepauka Rawiri munua yukie 'aixɨa wayurienike yutɨɨriyama, Mikari Tsahuri niweya kaneikunake, mɨpaɨ katinitatieni: —Neuxei hikɨ 'aixɨa pepɨka'ɨyɨ. 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie ti'aitame kemɨtiuka'iyari hepaɨ pepɨka'ɨyɨ. Pemutitsukwakakaitsie 'ukari te'uximayatamete 'awarita mepɨmatsixeiyakai. Tewi tixaɨtɨ mɨkatihɨkɨ hepaɨ pepɨyɨanekai.

Hikɨ Rawiri mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ne yurikɨ Yawé hɨxie nekaniyɨanekaitɨni, kemɨ'ane mɨnetsi'anayexei 'apaapa hetsiemieme meta 'a'iwama, 'ixaheritsixi nemɨtiwata'aitɨanikɨ, Yawé teɨterimama. 'Ayumieme Yawé hɨxie nepɨtiukaye'ani.
Peru matsi tawarita 'akuxi tixaɨtɨ nepɨkarayuyeitɨani, 'ekɨ kepemɨkatiku'eriwa, peru hikɨ mɨkɨ te'uximayatamete 'ukarawetsixi pemɨwaraxaxata mariweme mepɨnetsi'ayeitɨaka.
Hikɨ Mikari Tsahuri niweya tɨɨri kawarayexeiyaka kaniumɨni.
